text: I find myself in a place of learning and curiosity, surrounded by children in uniforms and an adult who seems to be guiding us—perhaps a teacher. The gentle questioning and attention to detail make me feel like a subject in an experiment or a lesson. Moving to the next space filled with bright colors, educational displays, and the word 'R+D,' I am reminded of the endless questions about how we see, know, and understand the world. I feel observed but also intrigued, part of a larger process of discovery.
